# 比较级探索台
a = 7   # Tom 高度
b = 5   # Jack 高度
hide()
ha = a * 12
hb = b * 12
fill_rect(-100, -60 + ha / 2, 50, ha, "#3b82f6")
write("Tom", -100, -80, "#1d4ed8", 11)
fill_rect(100, -60 + hb / 2, 50, hb, "#f59e0b")
write("Jack", 100, -80, "#b45309", 11)
write("Tom is tall.", 0, 130, "#64748b", 11)
if a > b:
    write("Tom is taller than Jack.", 0, 100, "#dc2626", 14)
if a < b:
    write("Jack is taller than Tom.", 0, 100, "#dc2626", 14)
if a == b:
    write("Tom is as tall as Jack.", 0, 100, "#16a34a", 14)
write("短词+er/est · 长词前 more/most", -70, -110, "#1d4ed8", 12)
write("big→bigger→biggest（双写g）", -30, -135, "#ea580c", 11)
write("as…as 中间用原形：as tall as", -45, -160, "#7c3aed", 11)

sections.title: 变化规则
sections.body:
【单音节：+er/+est（tall→taller→tallest）】【以e结尾：+r/+st（nice→nicer→nicest）】【辅音+y：ier/iest（happy→happier）】【重读闭音节双写：big→bigger】
多音节：more/most + 原形（beautiful→more beautiful）。
不规则：good→better→best；bad→worse→worst。

sections.title: 句型
sections.body:
【比较级：A + be + 比较级 + than + B】【最高级：the + 最高级 + in/of 范围】
Tom is taller than Jack. / Tom is the tallest in our class.
比较级前可加 much/a little 修饰：much taller（高得多）。

sections.title: 同级比较
sections.body:
【as + 原形 + as：和……一样】
Tom is as tall as Jack（一样高）。
否定 not as…as = 不如：This book is not as interesting as that one。
= less interesting than。

examples.q: 用 proper form 填空：This box is ___ (heavy) than that one.
steps: heavy 是单音节（以辅音+y 结尾）
变 y 为 i 加 -er
This box is heavier than that one.

examples.q: 翻译：Lucy 是班上最认真的学生。
steps: 范围 our class 用 in
Lucy is the most careful student in our class.
examples.tip: 多音节不加 est，前加 most

mistakes: as…as 中误用比较级（as taller as ✗）

exercises.q: He is ___ student in the class.（good）
